hypothesis: ATM IV may improve name-level volatility scaling versus the RV20 baseline; this is a risk-model comparison, not a directional-alpha hypothesis.

universe.basis: Current research universe with explicit survivorship limitation; departed and delisted expansion remains mandatory.

formation: Latest available option feature set per ticker and calendar month; prefer 31-90D then 8-30D bucket.

execution.entry: First adjusted close strictly after tradeDate
execution.exit: Shared median-close convention over the final ten sessions
execution.advPriceBasis: Raw close times volume over 20 sessions ending on or before tradeDate

benchmark: Equal-capital baseline with scalar one and identical sector, liquidity and cost rules.
primaryComparison: ATM IV minus RV20 monthly net return with circular moving-block bootstrap, block size four months.

biasChecks.lookAhead: Next-close entry and availability-dated labels required
biasChecks.survivorship: Limited by current universe and disclosed as a release blocker for production claims
biasChecks.liquidity: Missing ADV fails closed; sector and participation caps reduce weight without redistribution
biasChecks.delistedNames: Not yet covered; must be added before production claims
biasChecks.tuning: No holdout tuning; any parameter change requires a new separately labeled run
